descriptions.zh: 太空兽群已将我们的休眠种荚带到了§H[this.GetName]§!。通过向这颗行星发射一道聚能光束，我们可以刺激其生长，将这颗了无生机的星球转变为郁郁葱葱的新殖民地。
descriptions.en: Space Fauna have brought our dormant Seed Pods to §H[this.GetName]§!. By aiming a concentrated energy beam at the planet, we can stimulate their growth, turning an uninhabited rock into a verdant new colony.

descriptions.zh: 我们的种荚被太空兽群带到了§H[this.GetName]§!，他们在此处得到了§H[this.owner.GetName]§!的栽培和照料。通过向行星发射一道聚能光束，可以将这片森林转变为§H外星植物军§!。这颗行星上§H外星入侵植物§!的等级越高，就会生成越多的陆军。
descriptions.en: Space Fauna have brought our Seed Pods to §H[this.GetName]§! where they were cultivated and cared for by the §H[this.owner.GetName]§!. By aiming a concentrated energy beam towards the planet, we can stimulate growth, turning the forest into §HXenofloran Armies§!. The higher the level of the §HInvasive Xenoflora§! on the planet, the more armies will be spawned.

descriptions.zh: 把一些空间站人员投入到对缇扬奇的研究中，可以让我们进一步了解这些宁静而神秘的太空生物的习性。
descriptions.en: Dedicating some space station personnel to the study of the Tiyankis could give us further insights into the life of these pacific, mysterious voidborne creatures.
